item.title: Ostologia for Phaidstrato Achestlaides ~1319: ash raked, bones gathered, oar set upright.
item.description: Ostologia for Phaidstrato Achestlaides ~1319: ash raked, bones gathered, oar set upright. Elpenor asked for no more.

item.title: Philos #7981 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Pelorus)).
item.description: Philos #7981 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Pelorus)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
